description: This Java class implements a Freemarker TemplateTransformModel for formatting numbers within Freemarker templates in the Ofbiz framework. It provides a way to format numerical values based on locale and specified format strings, integrating with the web request context.

classes.name: OfbizNumberTransform
classes.description: A Freemarker transform for formatting numbers according to locale and specified format, used within Ofbiz web templates.

methods.name: getArg
methods.description: Retrieves a string argument from the argument map, handling different TemplateScalarModel types.

methods.name: getNumber
methods.description: Extracts a numeric value from the argument map, converting various template models to a Double.

methods.name: getWriter
methods.description: Returns a Writer that formats numbers according to the provided arguments and writes the output, considering locale and request context.
